title: Message import body (POST /v1/messages/import)
description: Direct mode (#865): the phone hands the history of its own radio to the hub when it is back in reach. Owner only; history only, never a send (nothing here reaches a radio); each message is stored with origin phone-direct. A message whose dedupe key the hub already has is skipped, so uploading twice adds nothing; the reply and the audit carry counts only. The route lands with #865 PR 3.

radio.description: The phone radio's own 6-byte public key prefix: the sender of its outgoing messages

peer.description: The other contact's key prefix on a direct message

state.description: An outgoing message's last state on the phone

sender.description: The sender's 6-byte key prefix on a direct message; ch<index> on a channel message, whose MeshCore frame carries no sender key (only '<name>: <text>')

dedupe_key.description: <sender>:<sender_ts>:<sha256 hex of the UTF-8 text>: the same on the hub (#856, radio intake) and in an import, so one message is stored once whichever path brought it
